reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, and if the Baby Nook really keeps my little one away from the big kids, I'd come back a couple of times on a weekday when I need to get a little work done with a real coffee. The attendance cap and daily cleaning log are what make it feel doable.
objection: Will bigger kids be running wild around my baby? The Baby Nook is gated, but the 3-5 year olds are in the same room, and I won't know how it feels until I'm there. Also I'm not sure wifi and a laptop are welcome, since it doesn't say.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing it in person on the free visit and finding the Baby Nook truly separate and calm, with a spot to sit and work.
